answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 37769 Country: India Title: In My area one Muslim guy opened a Dog Farm and he buys and sells variety of dog breeds Question: Kindly answer the following questions: (1) In My area one Muslim guy opened a Dog Farm and he buys and sells variety of dog breeds. He also does dog husbandry and caging. Kindly let me know, whether this business is permissible in Islam. (2) Doing business of pets is allowed in Islam? If so, which pets? Answer ID: 37769 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/436/B=1433) (1) If it is for the purpose of any benefit then it is allowable. (2) It is lawful to do the business of domestic animals like cow, ox, buffalo, goat, sheep, and camel etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
